description: Telemetry sink admin (D22): mint a verifier query token (per-run 'query' or verifier-wide 'global-query') in an interactive session so the plaintext token is not stored in Run Command history. It still transits the SSM service and, unless the box agent has SessionLogsDestination=none, is written to ipcTempFile.log on the box (readable by root) until ClockchainSinkAdmin-SessionCleanup removes it. Session Manager S3/CloudWatch logging must be OFF. Sink admin only.

kind.description: query (needs runId) or global-query (runId must be empty)

runId.description: Run id for kind=query; empty for global-query

linux.commands: sh -c 'CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=clockchain-mcp --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=telemetry-sink); [ -n "$CID" ] || { echo telemetry-sink is not running; exit 2; }; K={{kind}}; R={{runId}}; if [ "$K" = global-query ]; then [ -z "$R" ] || { echo runId must be empty for global-query; exit 64; }; exec docker exec "$CID" node dist/mint-cli.js global-query; else [ -n "$R" ] || { echo runId is required for query; exit 64; }; exec docker exec "$CID" node dist/mint-cli.js query --runId "$R"; fi'
